caption: The drawing is on a light beige or off-white paper and consists of two large rectangular shapes outlined in pencil near the center, each occupying roughly half of the width of the drawing. The tops of the rectangles have irregular, slightly jagged edges, each marked with small vertical lines and numbered or lettered notations, such as "7A," "11," "10," "10A," "9," "9A," etc. Inside the left rectangle, there is a centrally written label "M2" in pencil. To the left side of the left rectangle, the word "outside back" is written vertically. On the right rectangle, the notations at the top go from "4A" down to "1A" and "3," and on the far right, it is labeled vertically "outside front bodice on fold." Below the rectangles, there is a list of labeled parts written neatly in pencil, indicated by letters from A to M. Each letter is followed by a brief functional description of a clothing component, such as "B. Front Bodice," "C. Underarm Piece," "D. Bias Fold," "I. Sleeve with Cording," "L. Front Skirt," and "M. Back Skirt." The bottom section is separated from the rectangles above and contains only these textual annotations; all marks and text are in pencil with consistent line thickness. There are no colors except the natural tinge of the paper and the greyish tone of the pencil.
title: Dress (Pattern)
